name: Ekko Studio
description: Ekko Studio is a browser workspace for AI agents, with conversations, file tools, persistent memory, skills, and model settings. It includes both the Ekko and Hermes runtimes so you can choose an agent for each conversation.
short_desc: Manage your AI agent from your browser
author: EKKOLearnAI

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
